description: SvColorInput on its own in Svelte 5: a swatch that opens an animated, portalled popover with a hex field, the native color picker and a preset palette, emitting a hex string through onChange. It is the SvGrid color cell editor, standalone.

faq.question: What value does it emit?
faq.answer: A hex string such as #ff6600. Typing in the hex field, choosing a palette swatch or using the native picker all report through the same onChange.

faq.question: Can I supply my own palette?
faq.answer: Yes. Pass a palette array of hex values and the popover shows those swatches instead of the default set.

faq.question: Why does the popover portal?
faq.answer: So it can open from inside a scrolling panel or a grid cell without being clipped, positioned next to the swatch and closed on outside click or Escape.
